summary: The fund is an exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to meet its objective by having Corgi Strategies, LLC (the "adviser") actively manage the fund and, under ordinary market conditions, invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in a portfolio of companies materially involved in the ownership, operation, and enablement of global shipping and logistics networks that transport goods across oceans, ports, and multimodal routes. It is non-diversified.
